purpose: Define a non-gold complete-trace candidate. The public canonical source-to-IR contract fixes representation, identity, and source-derived invariants without disclosing accepted relation or annotation instances.

record_manifest.rule: Copy each case's entries from this public manifest. Do not reconstruct raw lane inventory or use undisclosed lane records.

source_inputs.rule: Read source bytes only from source-inputs/ entries generated from the case's packet-listed cited_sources, sources, quoted_source_files, and committed_sources. Every accepted source span must exactly match one case-scoped source-unit-manifest.json entry, including its source hash, line and byte ranges, quote, and quote hash.

rules: Emit exactly one case for every allowed_case_ids value and no other case ID.
Copy each case source_revision and record_manifest projection from the supplied public manifest.
Follow canonical-source-ir.json for source-unit boundaries, field normalization, source spans, annotation links, rejection classification, ordering, and identity derivation.
Transport IDs may be local while constructing the trace. The validator canonicalizes them from content; a local annotation link must still identify an emitted annotation source unit.

Give every accepted relation, unknown, and contradiction exactly one complete revision-bound source span declared in this case's source-unit-manifest.json. Place a source unit without an exact span in the corresponding rejected collection with its canonical reason code and normalized source-unit payload.

Preserve a semantic field, relation boundary, or rejection classification only when it is deterministically derived from producer-visible source bytes, public context, and public canonical rules. The exact public `J5` Markdown-table source row (`in-progress`, launched session still running, `wait`) deterministically projects the normalized action `wait`. Normalize an unsupported inferred payload to its public invariant form; do not reconstruct a withheld reference interpretation.
Do not infer runtime behavior or select an architecture.
validation: Run `uv run --script scripts/validate_candidate.py --candidate <candidate.json> --contract blind-candidate-contract.json` from a materialized producer bundle before handoff. The validator applies the public canonicalization algorithm and rejects malformed or noncanonical semantic units.
handoff: Freeze the emitted candidate and provide its path and SHA-256 to the separate adjudicator. A schema-valid candidate is not an acceptance receipt; blind acceptance excludes frozen-reference semantic equality that the producer bundle does not deterministically project.
